prompt_refinement.style_rules: Match vanilla Europa Universalis V map-mode and situation icons exactly: one single painted object, seen from a slight three-quarter angle, soft hand-painted shading with warm top-left light, saturated but natural colours, a thin darker edge so the silhouette reads on any background, no outline glow. The attached images are vanilla EU5 icons given ONLY as style references: copy their rendering style, scale and margins, never their subjects.
prompt_refinement.composition_rules: Exactly one clear object (or one tight group) filling about 85-90% of the square canvas, centred. Bold, simple shapes that stay readable at 32px; avoid hair-thin details such as chains, strings or fine text. No scene, no table, no ground plane, no circle or medallion behind it.

image.natural_prompt: A rustic glazed clay bowl heaped with a round bread loaf, a wedge of cheese and a few red apples, symbolising a household's everyday standard of living.
image.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, UI frame, circle, medallion, coin border, glow, halo, background scenery, table, hands, people, balance scale, coins, purple, pink, magenta in the subject, watermark

candidates.bowl: A rustic glazed brown clay bowl heaped with a round crusty bread loaf, a wedge of yellow cheese and two red apples, symbolising a household's everyday standard of living.
candidates.chicken_pot: A black iron cooking pot with a golden roast chicken resting in it and a little steam rising, evoking Henry IV's promise of 'a chicken in every pot'.
candidates.basket: A sturdy wicker market basket filled with a round bread loaf, a wedge of cheese, a small clay jug and a folded linen cloth, a household's weekly provisions.
candidates.bread_mug: A large round crusty bread loaf with a wooden mug of ale beside it, a common family's daily bread.

style_reference.notes: Vanilla map-mode icons (extracted from the installed game) used as style references; they are flattened onto the key colour before upload.

output.name: sol_living_standard
output.prompt_requirements: A single shared SOL icon used in the map-mode selector, the situation list, modifier icons and a small location-window button. It must sit naturally next to vanilla EU5 icons, which are a single object on a transparent background.
